name: frontier-broadside
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity FRONT-ON desktop website mockup, 1440x1000 landscape, for the existing Gunblood Multiplayer website. This is a functional browser game lobby, not a poster, room photograph, 3D diorama, or marketing landing page.
Input image role: the supplied image is the REAL GAME SCREENSHOT. Insert its two gunslingers, white arena, red READY lettering and revolver chambers intact as the main game preview; do not replace it with realistic cowboys or paint a different game.
Committed visual world: a premium OLD WEST SALOON ARCADE, late-1800s Western sign-painted character rendered as a polished modern usable website. Deep espresso and tobacco timber ground, subtle credible timber grain, antique brass fine rules and hardware, warm bone lettering, muted oxblood primary actions. Large authentic decorative Western slab/woodtype typography akin Rye for the Gunblood masthead, readable condensed sans akin Barlow Semi Condensed for controls and supporting copy. Strong square corners, precise spacing, restrained warm physical depth. Entire site belongs to this world, not generic white SaaS cards.
Preserve exact functional content and hierarchy. Header: GUNBLOOD, Browser duels, Source. Main interaction heading: Start a duel. Small line: Host plays left. Guest plays right. Primary real button: Host Game. Helper: Create a six-digit code for your friend. Secondary real button: Join Game. Helper: Already have a code? Enter it here. Footer disclosure: How direct play works. Attribution: Original game by Andrew Wolf / Wolf Games · Gunblood.com. Secondary footer: Unofficial multiplayer adaptation · Rendered with Ruffle.
Do not add introductory left-side paragraphs, slogans, statistics, campaign/ranking controls, online player counts, menus, fake code fields, account/login, “Choose a side to begin”, or any PeerJS promotional sentence. No giant empty hero. No browser chrome. No sci-fi neon, gradients, glass, pills, emojis, gratuitous gun illustrations, or UI labels in unreadable ornamental script. Real controls must be visually obvious. Use craftsmanship rather than excessive ornaments.
Composition C — THE FRONTIER BROADSIDE. Keep the same dark timber, brass, bone and oxblood saloon arcade visual world, but give it a graphic LETTERPRESS WINDOW arrangement. Header has a large assertive Western GUNBLOOD wordmark on the left with Source at the right, a thin brass double rule underneath. Main layout: the authentic white game screenshot occupies roughly the left 60%, in a strong squared dark-wood frame. On the right 40% a SINGLE antique bone/ivory print-paper control sheet, flat and beautifully set, subtly aged but never dirty: Start a duel in bold Western type, side line, and two stacked large buttons with exact helper copy. The paper is an actual functional invitation/control sheet, not a fake WANTED reward poster; no extra labels. Oxblood Host Game button, ink-and-brass outlined Join Game. Make the contrast between the luminous arena, restrained bone control sheet and deep espresso surround feel deliberate. Footer spans below with modest typography.
